meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.GradientAddInternal: This lemma handles the total Bochner integral convention in the weak-gradient definition; later measurable representatives and L² hypotheses are supplied where required.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsGradientField: The potential is not separately required to be measurable in this definition; the gradient-addition and Hardy arguments later handle that issue explicitly.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsLocalSquareIntegr: Despite the name, the input is not squared internally; callers pass squared velocity, derivative or potential norms when they require local L² integrability.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.LinearStateWeakLimi: No source reference outside this definition was found. The held-solution compactness assembly is expressed through HeldLimitClosureStatement, HeldLimitIdentifyStatement and HeldBoundedLimitStatement. The used compactness route carries held-solution and multiplier hypotheses. Those theorems are recorded as alternatives, without claiming that they prove this more general linear-state interface.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.SecondTracePairingS: The proof is named rapidSecondPair. Its declared result is RapidSecondPairStatement, whose definition repeats this interface exactly.
notes.Breakdown.SteadyCert.certificateWeakProf: This is an implication between named bridge propositions; it does not supply concrete numerical certificate data.
